sara: Quick ask — we ran int6 quant on Pulse-13B for onboarding. Need a concise recommendation for GTN: default vs safe fallback plus unit-econ snapshot.

arjun: TL;DR: int6 gives ~3.5x throughput, p50 similar, p95 +40ms; cost per 1k tokens est int8=$0.032 int6=$0.018 (~44% savings). Quality drop ~1.2 points on instr-qa overall; higher on abstractive summarization (~2.0).

mia: Can you paste the numbers and small scorecard we can copy into the GTN note?

eval-bot: EVAL SNIPPET:
```
sample=2500
instr-qa_mean: int8=83.6 | int6=82.4 | delta=-1.2
p50_latency: int8=110ms | int6=115ms
p95_latency: int8=200ms | int6=240ms
throughput_ratio (int6/int8)=3.5x
est_cost_per_1k: int8=$0.032 | int6=$0.018
simulated_fallback_rate=2.2%
```

sara: Ops note — enabling runtime flag `quant.mode=hybrid` recovered ~0.4 instr-qa points on average in our batch tests. Keep kv/prefix cache on for chat.

arjun: Routing we recommend (tested):
- default -> int6
- route to int8 if prompt_tokens > 1500 OR task in {summarize_long, creative_write} OR user_tier=enterprise
- always route to int8 for rerank/score tasks

mia: Elevator pitch draft for GTN: "Make Pulse-13B int6 the cost-default for conversational and high-volume inference — reduces token spend ~40-45% with small quality regressions (~1 point). Keep int8 as the safety path for long-context, creative, or score-sensitive workloads."

luis_product: Need 2-line elevator and 3 bullets (exceptions). Also a minimal canary plan we can copy into the product playbook.

sara: Elevator (2 lines): "Set Pulse-13B int6 as the default for latency-tolerant and bulk traffic to cut token costs by ~40% while keeping instr-qa within ~1 point. Use int8 for high-creative, long-context, or critical scoring tasks."

sara: Exceptions (3 bullets):
- Creative/temperature-heavy generation (temp >= 0.7) — prefer int8
- Long-context jobs (prompt_tokens > 1500) or multi-turn long-chat — prefer int8
- Any scoring/reranking or RLHF-sensitive evals — prefer int8

arjun: Canary plan (ops-ready):
- Phase 1: 2% of traffic -> 24h
- Monitor: rolling instr-qa mean, fallback-rate, p95 latency, error-rate
- Stop conditions: instr-qa delta <= -1.8 OR fallback_rate > 4% OR error_rate increase >0.4%
- If OK: Phase 2: 15% for 48h -> then 60% for 72h -> full roll

mia: Ops checklist: dashboards (instr-qa, fallback, latencies), alert thresholds per stop conditions, runtime flag toggle for `quant.mode`, automated rollback if error-rate spike.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/pulse13b-int6/canary @ 2026-03-19T10:15Z

mia: I pushed a one-paragraph scorecard to the docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/pulse13b-int6-scorecard-brief — @luis_product @arjun please review. Thanks :thumbsup:

sara: Perfect. Closing thread; will update with canary metrics in #eng-ml after 24h.
